title: Fluence Energy fiscal Q2 2026 earnings release
excerpt: Fluence reported fiscal Q2 revenue of USD 464.9 million, backlog of USD 5.6 billion, and reaffirmed fiscal-2026 revenue guidance of USD 3.2-3.6 billion and adjusted EBITDA guidance of USD 40-60 million.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supplies the latest reported backlog, order intake, quarterly margin and full-year revenue and adjusted-EBITDA guidance used in the thesis and valuation sensitivity.
